sections.title: Market Pulse: Futures Edge Up Ahead of Key Economic Events

items.headline: U.S. Futures Show Modest Gains; Focus Shifts to Nvidia Earnings and Fed Commentary
items.summary: U.S. stock futures are trading modestly higher this Tuesday morning as investors anticipate Nvidia's ($NVDA) earnings report due tomorrow and a crucial inflation report (PCE index) on Wednesday. The Federal Reserve's annual symposium in Jackson Hole, featuring a speech from Chairman Kevin Warsh, is also keenly awaited later in the week for insights into interest rate policy.

items.headline: Nvidia Earnings and PCE Index Awaited This Week
items.summary: Investors are keenly awaiting Nvidia's ($NVDA) second-quarter fiscal 2027 earnings report scheduled for after market close on Wednesday. Also due Wednesday is the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index for July, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, which will provide crucial insights into inflation trends.

items.headline: Fed's Jackson Hole Symposium in Focus
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's annual symposium in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, is scheduled for the end of the week, with Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh expected to deliver a significant speech. Markets will be scrutinizing his comments for any indications regarding the future path of interest rates.

items.headline: U.S. Sanctions on Iran and Retreating Oil Prices
items.summary: The U.S. announced broader sanctions aimed at Iran, warning countries doing business with Tehran could lose access to the U.S. dollar-based financial system. Despite rising tensions, oil prices retreated, with Brent crude falling 2.35% to $89.99 a barrel and WTI crude down 2.74% to $83.17 a barrel.

items.headline: Germany's Economy Shows Signs of Optimism
items.summary: Europe's largest economy, Germany, reported better-than-expected Q2 2026 GDP growth of 0.3%, surpassing the anticipated 0.2%. Business confidence also rose for the fourth consecutive month, reaching 88.8 points in August, suggesting a recovery from economic stagnation.

items.headline: BMO Financial Group Reports Q3 2026 Results
items.summary: BMO Financial Group ($BMO) announced Q3 2026 net income of $1,750 million, with adjusted net income rising 19% to $2,859 million and adjusted EPS up 22% to $3.96. The bank noted strong momentum in Capital Markets and Wealth Management.

items.headline: DICK'S Sporting Goods Releases Q2 2026 Results
items.summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. ($DKS) reported its second-quarter results for the period ended August 1, 2026, highlighting compelling new experiences driving athlete engagement and sales growth. Full year 2026 net sales are projected between $21.9 billion and $22.2 billion.

items.headline: EHang Holdings Reports Q2 2026 Financials
items.summary: EHang Holdings Limited ($EH) announced unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, including the sales and deliveries of 36 units of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft.

items.headline: Medical Services Sector Lags Broader Market
items.summary: The Medical Services industry has underperformed both its sector and the S&P 500 over the past year, with stocks in the industry collectively gaining 12% compared to the Medical sector's 13.5% and the S&P 500's 21% growth.
